stops.note: from a root meaning 'to form, arrange, set in order'
stops.meaning: an eon, a vast period of time

stops.note: adopted in English writing on Hindu and Buddhist cosmology
stops.meaning: an immense cosmological time period, equal to a day of the god Brahma

current_meaning: In Hindu and Buddhist cosmology, an immense period of time, roughly 4.3 billion years.
